target.title: fix(codex): cap compaction override warning cache via createDedupeCache
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes unbounded memory growth in the Codex app-server compaction override warning deduplication. The `warnedIgnoredCompactionOverrides` Set accumulated every warned override key forever with no eviction, TTL, or size cap.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced the unbounded `Set<string>` with `createDedupeCache({ ttlMs: 0, maxSize: 4096 })`, imported from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/dedupe-runtime` per extension boundary policy. The `check()` method provides touch-on-read LRU semantics without introducing a bespoke cache implementation.

## User Impact

No change for gateways handling fewer than 4 096 distinct ignored compaction-override keys. Gateways exceeding the cap may see one extra warning per evicted entry, a bounded trade-off versus the prior unbounded growth.

## Evidence

### Proof 1: Real module deduplication in the Codex compaction warning path

The focused vitest test imports the actual `compact.js` module and exercises `maybeCompactCodexAppServerSession` through the real `warnIfIgnoringOpenClawCompactionOverrides` path:

```text
$ pnpm vitest run --project extension-codex extensions/codex/src/app-server/compact.cache.proof.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ compact cache deduplication > deduplicates identical compaction override configs 37ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
```

The test calls `maybeCompactCodexAppServerSession` twice with identical config and verifies the second call produces zero additional warn-log calls — the module-level `createDedupeCache.check()` suppressed the duplicate.

### Proof 2: `createDedupeCache` with the same params (ttlMs=0, maxSize=4096)

The existing `src/infra/dedupe.test.ts` covers cache fill, duplicate suppression, max-size eviction, and LRU touch-on-read:

```text
$ pnpm vitest run src/infra/dedupe.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ createDedupeCache > ignores blank cache keys
 ✓ createDedupeCache > keeps entries indefinitely when ttlMs is zero or negative
 ✓ createDedupeCache > touches duplicate reads so the newest key survives max-size pruning
 ✓ createDedupeCache > clears itself when maxSize floors to zero
 ✓ createDedupeCache > supports explicit reset

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  5 passed (5)
```

### Proof 3: Plugin boundary contract passes

```text
$ pnpm vitest run src/plugins/contracts/plugin-sdk-package-contract-guardrails.test.ts

 ✓ keeps extension sources on public sdk or local package seams  ... 22 passed (22)
```
